derivation: prolonged form of a more primary (which is used in certain tenses);
def: to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking)

occurrences.text: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
